hardware.title: Hardware & Robotic Systems
hardware.description: We design and manufacture a wide variety of robotic systems. This includes service robots, collaborative robots, drones, and autonomous vehicles. We also build the underlying electronic systems, sensors, and embedded devices that power them.

software.title: AI & Software Platforms
software.description: On the software side, we specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative AI. We develop robust robotic operating systems, edge AI solutions, and cloud-based platforms to bring our hardware to life.

featured_products.name: Chikku Voice AI Kiosk
featured_products.tagline: Smart humanoid kiosk robot with natural real-time voice interaction for commercial environments.
featured_products.description: Chikku Voice AI Kiosk is a smart humanoid kiosk robot that functions as a professional virtual assistant. It engages customers in natural, real-time voice conversations, providing seamless information retrieval. Powered by a Hybrid RAG architecture combining Vector Search (semantic retrieval) and Knowledge Graph (relational retrieval), it accurately handles both standard Q&A and complex cross-logical queries.
key_features: Natural real-time voice conversations with customers
Menu and ingredient Q&A with allergy information
Dynamic pricing and policy information retrieval
Dish recommendation based on taste preferences
Indoor floor plans and spatial positioning
Turn-by-turn navigation to specific zones or booths
Location-based product category queries
Real-time stock level and pricing synchronization via POS integration

restaurants_fb: Detailed Q&A about menus, ingredients, flavors, and allergy info
Up-to-date pricing and restaurant policy inquiries
Dish recommendations based on preferred ingredients or tastes
supermarkets_malls: Floor plans and spatial positioning information
Turn-by-turn navigation to specific zones or retail booths
Location queries by product category (nearest booth from user's location)

featured_products.name: S-Robot
featured_products.tagline: Automated solar panel cleaning robot maximizing energy absorption and power output.
featured_products.description: S-Robot is a specialized robot designed for cleaning solar panels. It automates the maintenance process to keep solar panel surfaces consistently clean, maximizing solar energy absorption efficiency and power output. Deployable on rooftop solar installations (residential, commercial) and utility-scale solar farms.
key_features: Replaces manual labor for cleaning dust, sand, leaves, and bird droppings
Eliminates occupational hazards on high rooftops and steep slopes
Operates automatically on schedule without human supervision
Cleans significantly faster than manual methods
Prevents micro-cracks and glass scratching from human foot traffic
Chemical-free operation protecting anti-reflective coatings and ecosystem
Optimized water consumption or dry-cleaning capability

key_benefits.time_efficiency: Operates automatically on schedule; cleans faster than manual methods enabling immediate peak output restoration.
key_benefits.cost_savings: Reduces specialized cleaning labor and PPE costs; prevents panel damage from manual cleaning; optimizes long-term ROI and system lifespan.
key_benefits.eco_friendly: Optimized water usage or dry-cleaning; 100% chemical-free; protects anti-reflective coatings and surrounding ecosystem.

featured_products.name: WatchGuard6S
featured_products.tagline: AI-integrated 24/7 security, surveillance, and maintenance optimization robot for solar farms.
featured_products.description: WatchGuard6S is an AI-integrated robotic system dedicated to security, surveillance, and real-time monitoring of solar farms. It provides 24/7 protection with high-resolution cameras, thermal imaging sensors, and AI algorithms for continuous patrolling. It also automatically detects environmental hazards, automates maintenance workflows, and optimizes solar panel operational performance.
key_features: 24/7 continuous security patrolling and surveillance
High-resolution visual clarity under all lighting and weather conditions
Thermal imaging for night-time and low-visibility monitoring
Real-time AI anomaly detection, intrusion alerts, and equipment failure diagnosis
Comprehensive environmental metrics and temperature data collection
Fully autonomous navigation and mission execution without human intervention
Automated maintenance workflow triggering
featured_products.mission: Revolutionize security and maintenance operations in solar farms through cutting-edge technology, ensuring sustainable energy production with the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and accuracy.
